prisoner.name: Rick Seiber
prisoner.description: Rick Seiber was jailed for a nonviolent anti-nuclear protest at the RCA plant in Moorestown, New Jersey, on April 19, 1984. The protesters blocked the roadway during a Stations of the Cross action opposing military technology produced there. A contemporary report records a trespass conviction, a fourteen-day jail sentence and release on May 8, 1984.
prisoner.body: Source: Nuclear Resister25, PDF7/printed6. The report includes a group letter written from jail. Exact sentence-admission day and actual days served are unresolved; fourteen is the imposed sentence.

case.charges: Trespass while blocking the roadway at RCA plant, Moorestown, New Jersey, during anti-nuclear Stations of the Cross action.
case.sentence: Fourteen days in jail imposed for the April19,1984 action; actual confinement supported by group letter from jail. Explicit release May8,1984. Exact admission and sentencing days and actual custody total unresolved. Earlier similar action led to probation and is not treated as imprisonment. Source: https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR025_19840509small.pdf#page=7

prisoner.name: Sunshine Appleby
prisoner.description: Sunshine Appleby was jailed for ten days after a May 22, 1984 anti-nuclear protest at Electric Boat in Groton, Connecticut. Appleby threw blood on the steps of the administration building in opposition to Trident submarine production, was held on $100 bond, and was released when the charges were dropped.
prisoner.body: Source: Nuclear Resister26, PDF3/printed2. Ten days of actual detention are explicit. No release day calculated from this total.

case.charges: May22,1984 Electric Boat anti-nuclear blood-pouring protest; charges subsequently dropped, individual statutory charge unverified.
case.sentence: Held on $100 bond for ten days until charges were dropped. This is reported actual pretrial detention, not a prison sentence. Exact release day unverified; release year1984 only and January1 is a storage placeholder. Source: https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR026_19840802small.pdf#page=3
